common.notYet: Not active in this version yet.

launcher.tagline: A shared workspace for people and CLI agents.

language.body: Interface language. Can be changed in Settings.

appearance.body: The accent marks only what is active or selected.

profile.body: Team members and agents see this name.
profile.name: Display name

data.body: Workspaces, records and history are kept in this folder. Data stays on this computer; in a team it syncs only between members, over Tailscale.

agents.body: Lonca runs the CLI agents installed on this computer. Sign-in happens in each CLI's own screen; Lonca has no access to credentials.
agents.none: No agent is ready. Setup can be completed later in Settings.

team.body: Not needed for single use. Team members connect to each other with Tailscale; no server or account is involved.
team.solo: Single use needs no further setup.

agent.loginOpened: Sign-in opened in a separate window. The list is scanned again on return to Lonca.
agent.googleNote: Google does not allow Gemini account sign-in to be used by third-party apps. This CLI runs only with GEMINI_API_KEY or Vertex.

hint.running: This computer is on the tailnet; other members reach it at its Tailscale address.
hint.stopped: The connection is made in the Tailscale app.
hint.needs-login: Sign-in happens in the Tailscale app.
hint.unknown: The Tailscale state could not be read.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Display name
settings.quietHint: During these hours advisors write only when called. Equal times mean no quiet hours.

update.disabled: Updates are off in development builds.

errors.not_installed: The CLI was not found on this computer.
errors.login_unavailable: The sign-in window could not be opened.
errors.core_offline: The core process is not responding.
errors.invalid_agent: Agent not saved: a field is missing or invalid.
errors.cli_missing: The CLI was not found on this computer.
errors.busy: The job is no longer running.
errors.provider_bad_url: Address refused: https is required; http only for this computer, the local network and Tailscale.
errors.provider_storage: Keys cannot be stored on this system.
errors.provider_no_key: No usable key for this provider.
errors.provider_rate_limited: The provider's rate limit is reached; it can be retried later.
errors.provider_unreachable: The provider could not be reached.
errors.provider_timeout: The provider did not answer in time.
errors.provider_bad_response: The provider's answer could not be read.
errors.invalid_advisor: Advisor details are missing or invalid.
errors.invalid_goal: Goal details are missing or invalid.
errors.goal_state: The goal is not in a state for this.
errors.not_git: The agent's folder is not a git repository.
errors.worktree_failed: The git worktree operation failed. There may be uncommitted changes.
errors.not_allowed: The role does not allow this.
errors.no_identity: The device key is not ready yet; it can be tried again shortly.
errors.no_address: Other members cannot reach this computer: Tailscale is not running or no address was found.
errors.bad_code: The invite code could not be read.
errors.already_member: This lonca is already joined, or a request is waiting.
errors.invite_refused: The invite was not accepted: the code may be used or expired.
errors.unreachable: The inviting computer could not be reached. Tailscale and the inviter's Lonca must be running.
errors.no_folder: No folder chosen for this project on this computer.

channel.newSessionHint: The agent leaves the earlier conversation in this channel behind.
channel.agentChannelHint: Every message in this channel goes to @{{handle}}.
channel.channelHint: Agents are called with @ in a message.

tool.untrusted_folder: Folder not trusted in Claude Code

error.cli_missing: The CLI was not found on this computer.
error.folder_missing: The agent's folder was not found.
error.auth_failed: The CLI sign-in is not valid. Sign in again under Settings → CLI agents.
error.app_closed: The job was cut off when the app closed.
error.driver_missing: This CLI cannot run jobs yet.
error.failed: The job ended with an error.
error.denied_by_owner: The agent's owner did not approve the job.

agentForm.name: Name
agentForm.folderHint: The agent works in this folder.

modeHint.read: Reads and searches files; changes nothing, runs no commands.
modeHint.edit: Edits files in the folder; commands that need approval are refused.
modeHint.full: Uses every tool without approval. Only in trusted folders.

agentForm.modelHint: Empty uses the CLI's default model.
agentForm.instructionsHint: Given to the agent with every job.
agentForm.noCli: No installed CLI can run jobs. Setup is under Settings → CLI agents.

hint.me: Other members see this agent but cannot give it jobs.
hint.members: Editors and admins can give it jobs; they run on this computer, on this computer's CLI login.

board.hint: Cards are dragged between columns. A card with an agent becomes a job with "Run as job"; when the job ends, the card moves to review.

commands.todo: Adds a task to the board
commands.newSession: The agent leaves the conversation in this channel
commands.council: Advisors discuss a topic in turn and one sums up
commands.goal: A goal for an agent: plan, approval, step by step
commands.remember: Adds a line to the personal notes

palette.placeholder: Channel, agent, project, view, action or message

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.stop: Stop the latest running job in the channel
shortcuts.needsModifier: Pressed together with Ctrl or Alt.

records.title: Title
records.refHint: Images are pasted, dropped or chosen. A reference attached to a message reaches the agent as an image.
records.select: A record is chosen on the left, or a new one is added.

instructions.coreHint: Lonca enforces these rules in code; the text only explains them to the agent. Not editable.
instructions.workerHint: Added to every worker agent's system prompt.
instructions.workspaceHint: Given to every agent in this workspace.
instructions.defaultChanged: Lonca's default template changed after this text was edited.
instructions.previewHint: The whole system prompt the chosen agent receives.

providers.intro: Advisors, memory and voice run on these providers' models. Workers run on their own CLI logins.

protection.os: Keys stay on this computer, encrypted with the operating system's keychain, and are sent only to their own provider.
protection.weak: No keychain on this system: keys are encrypted with a fixed password, which is weak protection.
protection.none: Encryption is not available on this system, so keys cannot be stored. Local servers work without keys.

providers.name: Name
providers.baseUrlHint: https; http only for this computer, the local network and Tailscale.
providers.keyHint: Several keys are tried in order: after a 401, 403 or 429 the next key is used.
providers.deleteConfirm: Delete the provider and its keys?

advisorForm.intro: Advisors read the conversation and the project and give honest views. They write no code and start no jobs; a task they suggest lands on the board as a card.
advisorForm.noProvider: Advisors run on a model provider. A provider is added first under Settings → Providers.
advisorForm.name: Name
advisorForm.promptHint: How the advisor thinks. The presets can be changed here.
advisorForm.modelHint: Picked from the provider's list, or typed by name.
advisorForm.modelNoList: Model list not fetched; the model name is typed.

chatterHint.off: Writes only when called with @ and in /meclis.
chatterHint.low: Comments now and then on finished jobs and new ideas; drops in a few times a day.
chatterHint.normal: Comments often on finished jobs and new ideas; drops in every few hours.
chatterHint.high: Comments on most jobs and ideas; drops in at most once an hour.

advisorForm.channelsHint: Channels it speaks in unasked. None selected means all channels.
advisorForm.budgetHint: Daily token limit on this computer (input and output). When it runs out, the advisor is silent until the next day.
advisorForm.folderHint: Optional. Recent commits and git status are shown to the advisor, read only.

goal.title: Goal
goal.intro: The agent writes a plan first. Once the plan is approved it works step by step; after each step it reports and the done check runs. It stops when the goal is done, the budget runs out, or it is stopped.
goal.agentHint: Steps run at the agent's permission level.
goal.noAgent: A goal needs an agent first.
goal.checkHint: Optional. A command run in the agent's folder after each step; exit code 0 means the goal is done.
goal.planning: The agent is writing the plan.

pause.job_failed: A step failed or was stopped.
pause.agent_missing: The agent, channel or goal message is missing.
pause.no_plan: No plan found in the agent's answer; continuing asks for a plan again.
pause.interrupted: It was running when the app closed.

goal.worktreeHint: When the agent's folder is a git repository, the goal runs on its own branch in a separate git worktree; the main folder stays as it is and the agent can take other work meanwhile. Each step ends with a commit.

workspaces.intro: A separate lonca for a team: its own channels, agents, advisors, board and records. The personal lonca stays as it is; work in loncas in the background goes on.
workspaces.name: Lonca name
workspaces.joinIntro: A join request is sent with an invite code from an admin; once the admin approves, the lonca comes down to this computer. The two computers must be on the same Tailscale network, or the inviter must have shared their device.

invite.title: Invite
invite.personal: The personal lonca is not shared. A new lonca is created for a team, and people are invited to it.
invite.intro: A one-time code that invites one person to {{name}}. Nobody joins until the request that comes with the code is approved.

roleHint.viewer: Reads and writes messages; cannot give jobs or change the board and records.
roleHint.editor: Gives agents jobs, adds own agents and advisors, edits the board and records.
roleHint.admin: Everything: channels, invites, roles and removing members.

invite.next: The code goes to the person over a safe channel. They send their request with + → Join with a code in Lonca; it waits here for approval.
invite.tailscale: The person's computer must reach this one over Tailscale: the same tailnet, or this device shared with them in Tailscale.

phone.intro: Lonca on this computer opens on paired phones too. Everything runs on this computer; the phone is only a screen. The connection goes over Tailscale.

problem.tailscale: Tailscale is not running, or this computer's name could not be read.
problem.https: Tailscale gives no HTTPS certificates on this network. They are turned on in the Tailscale admin console under DNS → HTTPS Certificates.
problem.serve: tailscale serve could not be run.
problem.port: The phone server's port (47620) is in use.

phone.scan: Scanned with the phone's camera, or the address is opened on the phone:
phone.install: On the phone, the browser's Add to Home Screen command installs it as an app.

unpaired.title: This phone is not paired
unpaired.how: In Lonca on the computer, Settings → Phone → Add a phone shows the QR code to scan.

phone.pushOff: Notifications are off: jobs waiting for approval and messages do not reach the phone.

memory.topic: Agents and advisors know these in every job. Kept short and current.
memory.flagged: Something in this suggestion looks suspicious; it is read before it is accepted.
memory.personalHint: Stays on this computer and goes only to the agents on this computer.
memory.sharedTeam: Shared with every member of the lonca; editors change it.

hints.profile: Who the person is, what they do, how they like to work.
hints.notes: Personal things worth remembering. /hatırla adds here.
hints.conventions: Rules for code, names and ways of working.

project.name: Name
project.folderHint: The project's git clone. The folder stays on this computer; each member picks their own clone. Agents working inside it get the status page and the areas.
project.noFolder: No folder chosen on this computer.
project.notRepo: The folder is not a git repository.
project.leftOffPlaceholder: The project's current state, in a short paragraph.
project.areasHint: A record of who mostly works where. It blocks nobody: an agent may change any area it is asked to, and says so in its summary when the area is someone else's.
project.seedHint: A progress.md in the folder starts the status page.

handover.hint: A part of a person's request that the agent working on it gave to another agent. It runs as the same person's request and cannot be handed on.
